comment: Every public page route the sitemap advertises, excluding '/' which is emitted separately with priority 1.0. Lives as JSON, not as a literal inside src/app/sitemap.ts, so src/lib/__tests__/sitemap.test.mjs can assert each entry has a real page on disk without compiling TypeScript. Adding a route here without adding src/app/<route>/page.tsx fails that test. On 2026-07-25 this list still advertised /pricing, which had 404'd live for some time, and omitted /download and /status.
